notes.subject: במרגמה
notes.rationale: hapax; 'sling' (KJV, root רגם 'to throw stones') vs 'heap of stones' (JPS, cognate רגמה in Josh 10:11) — either the stone flies back out or it vanishes uselessly into the pile

notes.subject: מרגמה
notes.rationale: word occurs only here in the Tanakh

notes.subject: nimɔrɔ
notes.rationale: כבוד is literally 'weight/heaviness', hence honor; Bambara nimɔrɔ ('value/worth') captures the weight-sense partially

translation: I n'a fɔ kabakurun maralen don taabolo kɔnɔ cogo min na, o de ye nɔnmɔgɔ ma nimɔrɔ di ye.
